say:1:1510217001:0.text: According to the Halian soldiers, they came to this area to hunt wild animals.
say:1:1510217001:0.source_cn: 据呼临士兵所言，他们是来这附近狩猎野兽。

say:2:1510217002:0.text: Your gaze lingers on the vast, darkened bloodstain, its hue a dull and lifeless red. <style="highlight">The hunt, it seems, had reached its end long before your arrival.</style>
say:2:1510217002:0.source_cn: 你凝视着地上留下的大片血迹，颜色暗红，明显已经干涸。看...
